m6_notes: The proposed attractor 'Dynamic Load Management' assumes that immediate load shedding, demand response programs, and grid storage solutions can be seamlessly implemented and effective under all conditions. This requires conditions that may not be possible or have not been thoroughly tested in all scenarios, indicating Premature Idealism. The stability index of 0.85 suggests some level of stability, but the reliance on untested or ideal conditions undermines full stability.
